extract_species_id_from_msa_description: parse a UniProt MSA description string to extract the species identifier using get_identifiers
parse_uniprot_sequence_identifier: parse a UniProt sequence identifier like tr|A0A146SKV9|A0A146SKV9_FUNHE to get the species ID
extract_sequence_identifier_from_descrip: extract the first token of an MSA description as a sequence identifier string
create_identifiers_dataclass: create a frozen Identifiers dataclass instance with a species_id string field
match_uniprot_pattern: match a UniProtKB TREMBL or Swiss-Prot entry name against the compiled regex pattern
